newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber slips to lower closes on weaker cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber slips to lower closes on weaker cash.

text.p: An easier tone to cash lumber prices weighed on CME lumber futures and prices ended slightly lower in light dealings, traders said.
Slipping cash mill prices and reports of wholesaler discounts weighed on the market. However, losses were limited by the discount futures hold to cash values, they said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $406 per thousand board feet early Wednesday, down $4 from Friday and $5 under the week-ago quote.
Lumber closed $1.70 to $3.40 per tbf lower with May off the least at $396.30 and July off $2.40 at $395.20 per tbf.
